_comment: An agent is an EXECUTOR. It is not the owner of the database, the business
rules, the pricing or the project state. Everything it may do is on
`allowedOperations`, and anything not listed is denied — default deny, not

no network access in this repository. These entries define the CONTRACT an
integration would have to satisfy: which capabilities it claims, which task
types it may take, which operations it may call, what it must be given and
what it must return. The test suite drives them through a deterministic
mock executor, which is clearly labelled as such and is never the code path
